verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine, not an automation or workflow platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is outside its product category. The evidence describes serving, batching, quantization, and API features only. The deprecation policy concerns vLLM's own API and CLI lifecycle, not user-built automations, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
